sources.title: GPAW computational grids
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: ABINIT：k 點權重、對稱縮減與能帶統計
related.titleEn: ABINIT: k-point weights, symmetry reduction and band statistics
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：成本與精度分欄驗收；常數場通過只是必要而非充分條件。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Review cost and accuracy separately; passing a constant-field test is necessary but not sufficient.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「ABINIT：k 點權重、對稱縮減與能帶統計」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付不可約到完整網格映射、兩組加權結果、錯配反例與目標量限定說明。
related.differenceEn: Investigate ABINIT: k-point weights, symmetry reduction and band statistics using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver an irreducible-to-full-grid mapping, weighted results for both datasets, a permutation counterexample and a statement restricting the conclusion to the specified band statistic.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 計算兩種 N 的三次方，再分別乘八 bytes；把單場值數與軟體的峰值使用量分開。
以加權式與展開四筆值兩種方式求平均；另算未加權的兩點平均，說明它代表不同問題。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Cube each one-dimensional count and multiply by eight bytes for a single double-precision field. Keep this arithmetic separate from peak application memory, which may contain multiple fields, states, padding and temporary buffers.

Compute the result using both weighted arithmetic and the expanded list of four values. Also calculate the unweighted two-point mean and explain why it represents a different sampling measure rather than a competing approximation to the same formula.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: OpenFOAM：邊界通量符號與連續性殘差
related.titleEn: OpenFOAM: boundary-flux signs and continuity residuals
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：成本與精度分欄驗收；常數場通過只是必要而非充分條件。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Review cost and accuracy separately; passing a constant-field test is necessary but not sufficient.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「OpenFOAM：邊界通量符號與連續性殘差」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付邊界方向圖、分項通量表、局部與全域殘差及完整連續性假設。
related.differenceEn: Investigate OpenFOAM: boundary-flux signs and continuity residuals using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver a boundary-orientation map, individual flux entries, local and global residuals and the complete continuity assumptions supporting the chosen acceptance criterion.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 計算兩種 N 的三次方，再分別乘八 bytes；把單場值數與軟體的峰值使用量分開。
將正值與負值絕對量分組，再計淨值；同時算總絕對通量以說明不同診斷代表不同量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Cube each one-dimensional count and multiply by eight bytes for a single double-precision field. Keep this arithmetic separate from peak application memory, which may contain multiple fields, states, padding and temporary buffers.

Group inflows and outflow magnitudes, then compute their difference. Also calculate absolute throughput and explain why absolute flux, net flux and local continuity errors are different diagnostics rather than interchangeable totals.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
